description: Defines inline functions for encryption and decryption (NEA1, NEA2, NEA3) in the ocudu::security namespace, involving cryptographic operations with specific key, count, bearer, and direction parameters.

methods.name: security_nea1
methods.description: Performs NEA1 encryption/decryption using S3G stream cipher with specified key, count, bearer, and direction.

methods.name: security_nea2
methods.description: Performs NEA2 encryption/decryption using AES in CTR mode with specified key, count, bearer, and direction.

methods.name: security_nea3
methods.description: Performs NEA3 encryption/decryption using ZUC stream cipher with specified key, count, bearer, and direction.
